subject: Orion VPC variance and pricing request — access & audit terms
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@orionhealth.com>, Todd Lang <todd.lang@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal and request: VPC deployment + multi-year pricing

Hi Elena / Todd —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I've attached an updated SOW (v3) that reflects the VPC-hosted deployment model you requested and the 36-month committed usage profile we discussed. High level items:

- Deployment: Private VPC with dedicated subnet in us-west-2, private control plane (no public egress for model keys).
- Access: Orion SREs request read-only SSH host access for debugging on a limited basis; their legal is also asking for audit rights to logs and export capability for incident investigations.
- Retention: 90-day token/log retention (customer asked), 30-day optional export window.
- Pricing: I'm proposing a 25% multi-year discount off list for a 36-month committed consumption baseline (see SOW pricing table).

Both the VPC access and the discount are non-standard and will need internal clearance. I'm looping in our deal desk and legal contacts on the internal side (cc'd) to surface potential mitigations.

Next steps I want to move quickly on:
1) Internal review of the access/audit asks and approval on discount variance.
2) If we can reach alignment by EOD Thursday (8/26), we can deliver an MSA amendment + SOW for signature next week.

Attachments: Orion_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW and pricing), Orion_redlines.docx (customer redlines).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call with Deal Desk if helpful.

—Marcus

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@orionhealth.com>

Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:48:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal and request: VPC deployment + multi-year pricing

Marcus —

Thanks for the SOW. A few clarifications from our side so the ask is explicit for your internal stakeholders:

- Our SREs need the ability to initiate time-boxed SSH sessions into the private deployment host(s) strictly for debugging (we do not want a permanent agent). Sessions must be auditable.
- We will need read access to application-level logs and the ability to request a data export (for forensic purposes) up to once per quarter.
- The 25% discount is tied to our 36-month commitment and annual billing in arrears; this is a key commercial requirement.

If we can't get confirmed host access and export rights, the deployment won't meet our security team's gating criteria. Please let us know what your legal/operations can accept.

—Elena

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:22:05 -07:00
Subject: FW: Proposal and request: VPC deployment + multi-year pricing — Orion (requesting variance approvals)

Team —

Fwd'ing Orion's clarified asks (below). Summary of what we're being asked to make available that requires a variance:

1) Time-boxed SSH access for Orion SREs into private deployment hosts (for debugging). They want sessions to be auditable.
2) Read access to app logs and a quarterly data export capability (for investigations).
3) 25% committed discount for 36 months (list pricing is 100k/mo baseline in SOW).

Risks and proposed mitigations:
- Host access risk: Potential for unauthorized data access or configuration drift. Mitigation: ephemeral bastion sessions (scheduled, access granted only via our IdP), session recording (audit trail), approvals via our SOC admin.
- Export/audit risk: Data exfiltration. Mitigation: Exports limited to specific artifact sets, redaction of sensitive tokens, legal sign-off and mutual NDA addendum.
- Commercial risk: Stretch on margin if we push 25% discount. Mitigation: tie discount to a 36-month committed minimum revenue and add a managed services fee ($8k/mo) for SRE support.

What I'm requesting from Deal Desk / Sales Ops / Legal:
A) Commercial variance approval (discount) — propose we approve up to 20% instead of 25% unless Legal/Finance want to escalate.
B) Operational variance approval for controlled host access and quarterly export — propose formal addendum that limits scope, requires prior notice for sessions, and records all activity.

Please advise and, if approved, route to Legal for an addendum template. I can accept conditional approvals until Legal finishes language. Need a decision by EOD 8/26 to keep our signature timeline.

—Marcus
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Proposal and request: VPC deployment + multi-year pricing — Orion (requesting variance approvals)

Marcus / team —

Thanks for the clear write-up. After quick review with Sales Ops and Finance I can support a conditional variance with the following controls:

1) Commercial: Approve up to 20% off list for a 36-month committed ARR, conditional on a minimum annual billing ramp and execution of the MSA + addendum. Any deeper discount (>20%) requires SVP sign-off.

2) Host access: Approve time-boxed, auditable sessions only. Sessions must be initiated through our managed bastion that leverages SSO, be pre-approved by the customer's designated admin and recorded for a minimum of 180 days. No background processes or file transfers allowed during those sessions.

3) Exports & audit: Approve read-only access to application logs for the stated forensic use case. All export requests must go through our security request workflow; exports will be sanitized/redacted by our ops team before delivery. No unrestricted DB snapshots.

4) On-prem migration: If the customer later requests an on-prem or air-gapped deployment, require 60 days notice and a separate commercial/ops review.

5) Upside: Offer an additional 2% off if customer extends to 48 months.

Legal should draft an addendum that codifies the above (session controls + export workflow + liability carveouts). Routing to Legal: Laura / Aditya, please pick up and prepare language.

Marcus — you can confirm these conditional approvals to the customer. Once Legal provides the addendum we'll finalize.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
VP, Deal Desk & Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal and request: VPC deployment + multi-year pricing

Elena / Todd —

Thanks for the patience. Quick update on internal approvals and next steps:

- Commercial: We can extend a 20% committed discount for a 36-month term (list pricing reflected in the attached SOW). There is an additional 2% concession available if you move to a 48-month commitment.
- Host access: We will provide time-boxed, auditable SSH sessions via our managed bastion (sessions recorded, SSO-protected). Sessions must be scheduled and approved in advance; no file transfers allowed during sessions.
- Exports & audit: Read-only access to application logs is approved for forensic investigations; export requests will be processed via our security request workflow and sanitized/redacted by our ops team.
- On-prem requests: Any future on-prem or air-gapped request will require a separate ops/commercial review (60-day notice recommended).

Next steps to keep momentum:
1) Legal will prepare a short addendum capturing the access controls and export workflow — Laura / Aditya are on it.
2) If the revised commercial terms above are acceptable, we'll send an MSA amendment + SOW via DocuSign for signature (links below).
3) Schedule a 60-minute technical kickoff with our infra team to walk the bastion/session playback and export/redaction process.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/submit/ORH-SOW-v3
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ORH-2026-0043

Please confirm and we'll push the draft to Legal.

—Marcus
